arootah-arootah:lever:610d25bd-3b21-46ac.title: Fractional Compliance Manager (Advisor Network)
arootah-arootah:lever:610d25bd-3b21-46ac.description: Opportunity Overview Arootah engages a curated network of senior operators to support clients across the alternative investment industry, including hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices. Advisors are deployed on project-based engagements when client needs match their expertise. Joining the network does not guarantee placement; it provides access to opportunities as they arise. Why Join the Arootah Network Alt-industry-only engagements with hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices
responsibilities: Provide advice and guidance to Arootah clients who seek help with their Compliance programs. This will involve consulting toAlternative Asset Firm and Family Offices and sharing your experience as a Director Compliance or Compliance Manager in helping clients to:
Develop realistic and effective monthly action plans.
Identify internal and contextual roadblocks.
Break apart goals into actionable steps.
Devise a plan of action for each goal.
Provide the client with resources associated with implementing their action plan.
Implement policies, procedures, and control measures.
Evaluate each client’s advancement toward goal actualization through key performance indicators (KPIs) and scoring matrices.
Maintain and share detailed and accurate records of consulting results (challenges, breakthroughs, etc.).
Independent risk management routines to assure proper alignment exists with SEC expectations in anticipation of SEC exams and audits.
Regulatory requirements as it relates to NFA/CFTC registered Commodity Pools, and other compliance-related activities as they relate to these products and/or entities.
Broker/Dealer knowledge and experience in working with FINRA rules/regulations.
Extensive experience drafting and updating Code of Ethics and Compliance Manuals.
Develop the Group's Risk & Compliance program, roadmap, and strategy.
Assist the firms’ staff to ensure compliance on regulatory matters throughout the business development and investor relations processes.
Create and maintain the firm’s Form ADV, Parts 1 and 2 as well as regular and periodic regulatory filings.
Experience with internal controls relating to insider trading, material nonpublic information, front-running and other trading activity.
Ongoing employee training and new hire compliance training.
Proactive compliance support and assuring all regulatory and policy matters are well understood and effectively managed.
Collaborate with firm management and outside service providers to remediate compliance findings identified in internal and external examinations and audits.
Facilitate annual regulatory risk assessment and providing senior management with recommendations based on the results.
Create programs and best practice execution in areas such as electronic correspondence, email/record retention, outside business activities and other functional areas.
Develop and oversee annual compliance testing.
Provide guidance to internal groups related to client fee billing process and processing of investment advisory agreements.
Ad-hoc and special projects as requested by the client.
qualifications: Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, or Business Administration, or in a related field.
MBA, Juris Doctor, M.S. in Law, or Legal Studies a plus.
Certifications: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), or Certified Internal Auditor a plus.
5+ years compliance experience, with at least 3+ years as a Director of Compliance, Compliance Manager or similar level at a Hedge Fund or Family Office.

Solid experience dealing with Federal securities laws and Federal, state, and local regulations guiding financial institutions including, but not limited to the Investment Company Act of 1940, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, Securities Exchange Act of 1933, and Regulation CF, etc.
Demonstrated experience interacting and managing relationships with regulators.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Advanced computer skills – Microsoft Office Suite.
Outstanding analytical skills, detail-oriented, proactive, and self-motivated.
Collaborative, diplomatic, and can cross-functionally partner with different internal stakeholders.
Experience in/comfort with a role with a degree of ambiguity, requiring proactive analysis and action.
Proven to work independently, prioritize work, and achieve results.
Ability to quickly build rapport and work with a team.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:56ef2aa8-4e6c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Associate Project Manager - Creative Ops based in United States. This role supports the successful planning and execution of creative initiatives across campaigns, brand, packaging, and innovation. You’ll serve as a key operational partner, keeping projects organized, aligned, and moving from intake through final delivery. Working across Creative, Marketing, Brand Strategy, Commercial, Product Development, Regulatory, and Operations, you’ll coordinate multiple stakeholders and workstreams. Your attention to timelines, dependencies, documentation, and communication will help teams deliver high-quality work efficiently. You’ll also identify opportunities to improve workflows, strengthen processes, and increase operational visibility across the creative portfolio. The role offers an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while developing toward broader project leadership responsibilities. You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Creative Operations and contribute directly to a culture of accountability, creativity, and operational excellence. Support creative projects from initial intake through final delivery across campaigns, packaging, brand, and related initiatives. Build and maintain project timelines, workback schedules, trackers, project plans, and supporting documentation. Coordinate project kickoffs, status meetings, reviews, approvals, and stakeholder communications to keep work progressing smoothly. Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and potential roadblocks. Ensure project information, timelines, assets, deliverables, and documentation remain accurate, organized, and up to date. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, align expectations, clarify responsibilities, and support execution. Assist with creative intake management, project routing, workflow coordination, and prioritization across active workstreams. Support resource tracking and workload planning to help balance team capacity with project demands. Maintain project management systems and reporting tools that provide clear visibility into active initiatives and upcoming priorities. Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and operating practices that increase team efficiency and effectiveness. Partner with senior project managers and creative operations leaders on portfolio management and broader operational excellence initiatives. Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment while helping creative teams stay focused on delivering impactful work. Requirements 2–5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or a related field. Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, creative development, brand initiatives, or comparable cross-functional projects. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across different teams and stakeholder groups. Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple moving pieces accurately without losing sight of broader priorities. Ability to identify project risks, dependencies, and process improvement opportunities and take proactive action to address them. Experience using project management tools, workflow systems, and reporting platforms. Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with a proactive approach to working across functions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:76e033a5-5f2b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Développeur(se) Fullstack Next.js based in Ireland. As a Fullstack Next.js Developer, you’ll join a lean, high-performing technology team building and scaling an AI-powered SaaS product with strong market traction. You’ll take ownership of the application’s server-side layer while also collaborating closely with front-end developers on product delivery. The role offers substantial technical responsibility, from data access and authentication to complex business logic and third-party integrations. You’ll work with a modern stack including Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn, with AI tools integrated into the development workflow. The environment is fast-paced, autonomous, and focused on shipping high-quality software rather than basic CRUD development. This is an opportunity to become a key technical contributor to a growing product while helping shape its continued evolution. Own the application back end integrated directly into the Next.js application, including Server Actions and API Routes. Design and manage efficient data access and the underlying application data layer. Develop and maintain third-party integrations and authentication mechanisms. Implement and optimise complex business logic, including credit management, job pooling, and API timing or delay management. Collaborate closely with front-end developers to support seamless integration and ensure consistent product experiences. Contribute directly to the product roadmap and deliver features aligned with business and user needs. Act as a technical contributor who proactively proposes improvements and solutions rather than simply executing predefined specifications. Write clean, maintainable, robust, and sustainable code that can evolve with the product. Investigate and address performance challenges to ensure a reliable and responsive application. Integrate AI-powered development tools into the engineering workflow while applying appropriate technical judgement to their output. Communicate effectively within a fully remote team and maintain strong alignment across development activities. Remain adaptable and, when required, contribute to other products within the wider SaaS portfolio. Requirements: 5–10 years of professional fullstack development experience, with a level of seniority allowing you to take ownership of the application back end. Proven experience working in SaaS environments and delivering production-grade web applications. Strong hands-on expertise with Next.js, particularly its integrated server-side capabilities such as Server Actions and API Routes. Solid experience with data access, third-party integrations, authentication, and complex application business logic. Strong TypeScript skills and practical experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn. Good understanding of modern meta-frameworks, with Next.js experience preferred; familiarity with alternatives such as TanStack Start or Nuxt is a plus. Ability to design and implement clean, maintainable, modular, and scalable code. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as an integral part of the engineering workflow. Strong autonomy and ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for a significant technical area of a product. Collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with front-end developers and other technical stakeholders. Strong remote communication skills and ability to work effectively within a distributed team. Proactive approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and suggest technical or product improvements. Fluent French is essential, as it is the team's primary working language. Sufficient English proficiency to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Benefits: 100% remote working opportunity from anywhere in Europe. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c3a9b3e5-9155-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Operations & Service Growth based in France. This is a high-impact leadership role combining business building, commercial growth, and hands-on operational management. You will turn an approved business vision into an executable roadmap while launching and scaling a technology-enabled service operation. The role combines strategic ownership with direct involvement in sales, service delivery, partnerships, and operational execution. You will oversee multi-location operations and work through Area and Location Managers to maintain consistent service quality and customer outcomes. A key focus will be improving digital conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and contribution margins. You will also build scalable systems that reduce manual work and create more predictable, repeatable operations. This opportunity is ideal for an entrepreneurial operator who enjoys building new businesses while simultaneously improving established operations. Translate an approved business vision into a clear, executable strategy, roadmap, operating model, and measurable priorities. Lead the launch and early development of a new technology-enabled service business, taking ownership of initial sales, service, and operating processes. Build and strengthen customer, merchant, delivery-partner, and other strategic networks required to support business growth. Provide hands-on, COO-level leadership across multi-location operations, working through Area and Location Managers to ensure consistent execution. Establish clear operational standards, performance expectations, and accountability mechanisms across locations and teams. Own service quality, speed, customer experience, and business outcomes across the operating network. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Drive improvements in online sales conversion, customer retention, digital performance, and contribution margin. Use AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve decision-making and reduce dependence on manual follow-up and individual intervention. Balance strategic growth initiatives with field-level execution, continuously identifying opportunities to improve both the business model and day-to-day operations. Develop managers and strengthen their ability to lead teams, meet performance expectations, and operate independently. Requirements Significant senior-level experience in operations, commercial leadership, business development, or a closely related field. Demonstrated track record of building, launching, scaling, or significantly improving a business, service operation, or distributed network. Strong experience in multi-location restaurant, delivery, logistics, hospitality, or service-based operations. Proven business development and partnership experience, with the ability to build relationships that generate commercial value. Strong understanding of operational performance, customer experience, service quality, and commercial growth. Hands-on experience using AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve business processes and decision-making. Strong leadership skills with experience managing managers, setting expectations, measuring performance, and developing team capability. Ability to operate comfortably across both high-level strategy and hands-on operational execution. Experience with online sales, e-commerce growth, digital conversion, or customer retention is a plus. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in environments where processes are still being built and refined. Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to personally address operational challenges when necessary. Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making abilities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea097373-0476-.title: Senior Product Designer - Compute, Nebius Console
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea097373-0476-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer - Compute, Nebius Console based in Netherlands. This is a senior product design opportunity focused on shaping complex compute experiences within a modern cloud infrastructure platform. You will own the design journey from discovery and problem definition through delivery, launch, and iteration. The role centers on turning sophisticated cloud workflows into intuitive, scalable, and reliable experiences for highly technical users. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers to solve challenging product problems. Your work will influence how users create, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and manage cloud resources at scale. It’s an ideal environment for a systems-minded designer who enjoys technical depth, thoughtful interaction design, and meaningful product ownership. Own the end-to-end product design process for compute-related features, from discovery and problem framing through delivery, launch, and continuous iteration. Design clear, scalable workflows for complex cloud infrastructure use cases, including resource creation, configuration, management, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Translate business objectives, technical constraints, and user needs into coherent user journeys, information architecture, interaction models, and detailed product experiences. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, UX Researchers, Designers, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle. Explore and validate design hypotheses using user research, prototypes, product data, customer feedback, and insights from internal and external users. Present design concepts, decisions, trade-offs, and rationale clearly to cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Partner closely with engineers during implementation to ensure designs are executed accurately, consistently, and to a high quality standard. Contribute to the evolution and maintenance of the design system, helping improve consistency, usability, accessibility, and product quality. Participate actively in design reviews, critiques, and collaborative working sessions while sharing reusable patterns and contributing to design standards. Help establish thoughtful interaction models for technically sophisticated products while balancing usability, consistency, feasibility, and innovation. Requirements 6+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer working on digital products. Strong product-thinking skills and the ability to connect user scenarios, business objectives, technical constraints, and broader product systems. Proven experience designing complex B2B, SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure products, administration platforms, or similarly technical experiences. Strong systems-thinking capabilities, with excellent attention to detail and a structured, methodical approach to solving complex design problems. Ability to balance user needs, technical feasibility, consistency, scalability, and innovation when designing sophisticated workflows. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including complex user flows, components, variants, and interactive prototypes. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions clearly and constructively to product and engineering stakeholders. Experience working closely with engineers throughout implementation and an understanding of how technical constraints influence product design. Familiarity with cloud concepts such as virtual machines, compute resources, networking, storage, quotas, permissions, and monitoring is highly valuable. Experience designing cloud consoles, infrastructure platforms, developer tools, or other technically complex products is a plus. Experience with UX research, usability testing, customer interviews, or analyzing qualitative and quantitative product feedback is advantageous.

jobDescription.title: Senior Product Designer - Compute, Nebius Console
